notes.title: Sorry! This is a release delay announcement...
notes.notes:
Dear adventurers, please allow us to drop to our knees first: we’re truly sorry!!!

Our magical tower-defense game Relic Guardian, originally scheduled to launch on September 3rd, will be delayed.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325368/eaf9de0355076c76e927daf64c4588a8d1574a1d.gif"]

Just yesterday, Silksong announced its release date of September 4th. (Yes, we can finally unequip Unbreakable Luck!)

We’d love for everyone to have enough time to fully enjoy the world beyond Hallownest.
From our perspective, launching so close together would make our promotional work extremely difficult.

Therefore, we’ve decided to move our release date to: October 22nd!

We know this means you’ll have to wait a little longer, but during this time we’ll continue polishing the achievement system and the difficulty editor for challenge stages. Our goal is to bring you a more complete and enjoyable experience at launch.

We’re deeply grateful for all your support and encouragement along the way—every comment we see gives us strength! Please bear with us a little longer, and on October 22nd, join us on Vortex Isle’s magical adventure!

As a small treat, here’s a little in-game Easter egg for you: Vortex Isle, Hollow Knight edition (?).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325368/f5ac115b3a37d52620191179e0d9c9847099a76c.gif

notes.title: 3.26 Demo Update Log
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We've just rolled out a new demo update, addressing issues related to Pani·Asrai and optimizing the battle mechanics and attack effects of the Lake Fairy in Stage 1-4. Additionally, we've made improvements to the upgrade logic for defense towers.

We hope this update brings you a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience! If you encounter any issues while playing, feel free to join our Discord and share your feedback~ 🎮✨

【Fixes】

 Fixed an issue where Pani·Asrai would stop moving under certain conditions.
 Fixed an incorrect reward configuration in Stage 1-4—rewards will now unlock properly.
 Fixed an incorrect counter issue for Sacred Tree Sharpshooter Form 4.
 Fixed an issue where Molten Flame Demon could infinitely stack attack power.
 Fixed several minor bugs.

【Optimizations】

 Adjusted the battle mechanics and visual effects of the Lake Fairy in Stage 1-4—she's now more powerful!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325368/73d919d7898c5ea159cc34f31a7d4328fd4cc8a1.gif

 Improved the display of attack ranges, making them more precise and accurate.
 Optimized the upgrade logic—now, upgrading high-level defense towers and unlocking skills no longer requires clicking.
 Various minor optimizations.


We will continue to pay close attention to your feedback! If you encounter any issues in the game or have suggestions, feel free to reach out to us on Discord. We’re always listening to your thoughts and working hard to optimize the gaming experience! 🚀🎮

notes.title: Our demo has been updated! Here is the 2.26 update log.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, our demo has been updated! This update mainly focuses on fixing the bugs we've collected from your feedback.

Here are the fixes in this update:
[olist]
 Fixed a bug where the boss wouldn't appear after the cutscene in certain situations.
 Modified the UI and detail display for barracks-type towers.
 Fixed text alignment issues in certain cases.
 Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor would disappear if the hero portrait was clicked to summon before the tutorial UI popped up.
[/olist]
We will continue to pay close attention to everyone's feedback and suggestions! If you encounter any issues in the game or have suggestions, feel free to contact us on Discord! 

We will also keep an eye on the group to gather your feedback and work hard to improve the game experience!

notes.title: Demo Patch 2（2024/11/19）
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is Mystrigger.

We have released the second patch for the demo version. Based on feedback from demo players, we've optimized some UI elements that were not effectively conveying information. Our intention is to enable players to experience the game more smoothly.

During this time, we are also adding meticulously crafted content to the full version of the game, hoping that it will meet your expectations.

-Corrected some text errors
-Bugs...Bugs...

+Improved interaction UI for better clarity
+Added key prompts
+Implemented frame rate lock feature
+Introduced tooltips for various information

If you enjoy our game, please add it to your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2064610/

Thank you for your support, and we hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: Demo Patch 1 (2024/08/01)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is Mystrigger.

How has everyone enjoyed the demo so far? We’ve released the first patch for the demo in hopes of providing you with a more stable experience.

-Fixed an issue where enemies could get stuck at corners in certain situations.
-Corrected display errors for some hero and enemy icons.
-Added text information for a hidden enemy.
-Fixed issues that could cause errors in the tutorial flow for some reasons.
-Corrected the positioning of some indicators.

+The game should now correctly detect the player’s language upon initial startup.

We will continue to optimize the game experience, so if you have any issues or suggestions, please provide feedback in the community.

If you enjoy our game, please add it to your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2064610/_/

Thank you for your support, and we hope you enjoy the game!
